This means that an appropriate estimate of the fraction of customers who purchased fruit is \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"the fraction 20 over 80\">\x3C/span>, or \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"one fourth \">\x3C/span>.
